research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Visual One is engaged in developing systems for custom event detection for surveillance cameras, as described in the title 'Custom event detection for surveillance cameras.' Their work involves training and using event recognition models to identify user-defined event types within camera feeds, particularly from fixed-view surveillance cameras with consistent positioning and background. This research focuses on enabling surveillance cameras to recognize specific events within video images.

overview_description.description:
Visual One enables surveillance cameras to recognize specific events using AI. Their software allows users to create custom alerts for events they care about and notifies them when those happen.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
